chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Hakam ibn Bahlul, from a man, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام regarding His, the Exalted's, saying:
And it has certainly been revealed to you and to those before you: if you associate partners, your deed will surely be nullified.
He عليه السلام said: It means, if you were to associate other than him in the wilayah.
Rather, worship Allah and be among the thankful.
Meaning: Rather, worship Allah through obedience, and be among the thankful that I strengthened you with your brother and your cousin.

key_terms.أَشْرَكْتَ: you associated partners; here interpreted in relation to wilayah
key_terms.الشَّاكِرِينَ: those who are thankful to Allah
key_terms.الْوَلَايَةِ: the divinely designated authority and guardianship
key_terms.فَاعْبُدْ: so worship; here explained as obeying Allah

ai.seo_question: How is Qur'an 39:65-66 interpreted in relation to wilayah in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith presents an interpretation of the verse as referring to shirk in the matter of wilayah, warning against assigning that authority to other than the one designated. It also explains worship here as obedience to Allah and gratitude for the divine support granted through the Prophet's صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم brother and cousin.
